name: component_capability_evolver
description: Reusable periodic evolution review. A normal Model judges whether repeated work deserves a reusable artifact, then a bounded Agent searches before proposing or creating it.

component.name: capability_evolver
component.description: Turn repeated failures or repeated work into a Skill, Tool, Knowledge or SubDAG without keyword hardcoding.

evolver.description: Identity that evaluates and implements reusable capabilities

judge_verification.description: Require evidence before an evolution is marked successful

approve.prompt_text:
允许 Agent 搜索并在确实没有重复能力时实现以下进化候选吗？
${ctx.evolution_decision}

evolve.instructions:
Search exactly once before changing anything for this approved proposal: ${ctx.evolution_decision}
Call search_capabilities with the proposed search_query and relevant kinds. Do not create or activate in this node.

implement.instructions:
Review the immediately preceding search result and this approved proposal: ${ctx.evolution_decision}
Perform exactly one action. If an adequate capability exists, activate it. Otherwise create the smallest proposed artifact. Implement the proposal's typed interface and acceptance_test without embedding hidden answers or task-specific constants. For create_skill, pass parameters_schema as an actual JSON object (not a JSON-encoded string); its public properties must exactly match the Python function signature and must omit runtime-only _context. A workspace-aware function itself should accept optional _context=None and resolve the workspace from (_context or {}).get('workspace') or os.getcwd(). For Knowledge, preserve source and scope. For a Harness, publish typed component inputs/outputs and a bounded runnable control flow. Do not search again. A write is not yet success; the following nodes verify the persisted artifact.

repair.instructions:
The single mutation attempt failed with this exact evidence: ${ctx.mutation_evidence}
Correct only the reported interface/validation problem and retry the same approved action exactly once. Do not search, propose a different capability, test copied code, or claim success without a successful tool result.

verify.instructions: Verify the successful persisted activation or mutation against the proposal acceptance_test with exactly one highest-value persisted-artifact check. For an executable Skill created for the current Identity, call verify_identity_skill with its exact name and 1-4 representative normal/error cases; that tool activates and executes the installed artifact through the normal workspace policy without granting arbitrary Identity-directory reads. Never import an Identity file with read_file or run_command from outside the Task workspace, and never test copied inline code. For Knowledge, inspect it through search/activation evidence; for a Harness or Agent, validate its saved graph/interface and run a bounded smoke task when possible. For activation, query the catalog and confirm the activated reference. Ensure the evidence contains an explicit PASS marker. Do not mutate and do not perform multiple searches.

verification_skill_repair.instructions:
The first installed-Skill verification call failed: ${ctx.verification_evidence}
Retry verify_identity_skill exactly once for the same persisted skill, correcting only the reported case arguments or expected subset. Do not read task files, invoke another tool, mutate the Skill, or test copied inline code.

verification_repair.instructions:
The first verification call failed or was blocked: ${ctx.verification_evidence}
Retry the same persisted-artifact acceptance check exactly once, correcting only the reported invocation error. For a current-Identity executable Skill, use verify_identity_skill rather than reading or importing files outside the Task workspace. For run_command, do not use cd and omit cwd; the process already starts in the Task workspace. Test the installed artifact itself, not copied inline code, and print PASS on success. Do not mutate or broaden the proposal.

value.reason: The deterministic verification tool failed; model self-report was not accepted.

verification_report.instructions: Report the evolution action and its concrete verification result. Include capability name/path, the exact check, exit status or catalog evidence, and any failure. Do not call tools.
